definitions.inputTokens: Cumulative reported inputs across model replies, including replayed context; not unique input text.
definitions.outputTokens: Reported output tokens, including reasoning where the provider reports it.
definitions.reasoningTokens: Explicit provider-reported reasoning-token counter; subset of output, never added to output. Null means not reported.
definitions.solverEstimateUsd: Known target-solver usage estimate only; excludes search/helper fees, unknown failed requests and unpriced local hardware.
definitions.endpointTypesComplete: Prospective audit of public required endpoint types/finiteness. Not a mutation of archived grades; finite wrong estimates remain eligible misses.
definitions.effort: Declared provider reasoning setting; labels are not equal compute across models.
definitions.broadProfiles: Archived original/web 260 pairs across 26 profiles; no new repeats. Original native input/output use settled proxy response usage across root and children; native web usage is not reconstructed here. Any unmeasured-output bounds remain separate from reported tokens.

qualifications: The full50 Luna comparison also changes web backend. Exa20 matches backend family but retains guard, prompt, context delivery, scheduling and time differences.
The scientific-tool package includes explicit use instructions; tool access and prompting are not separately isolated.
Mechanical failures remain in attempted-run denominators and are not scientific misses. No answer is repaired or retried.
Reported token totals exclude unknown failed-request usage; zero missing usage must not be inferred.
Cost plots use known solver estimates, not invoices. Nemo local hardware is unpriced, not free.
No general model ranking, causal benefit, equivalence or training-membership conclusion is established.
